name: gpu_cloud_pricing
description: On-demand GPU cloud pricing, one row per offered instance configuration.

search.topic: on-demand GPU cloud hourly pricing per GPU H100 A100 comparison

_notes: The pattern/deny_pattern constraints are load-bearing, not decoration.
Without them a `string` field accepts anything, and an extractor that reads
a page's cost-example table instead of its pricing table scores just as
well as one that reads the right table. Observed before tightening: rows

fields.name: provider
fields.description: Company offering the instance, e.g. 'Lambda Labs'. Short proper noun, never a duration or a worked example.

fields.name: gpu_model
fields.description: GPU model as advertised, e.g. 'H100 SXM'. Must name a real accelerator.

fields.name: gpu_count
fields.description: GPUs per instance. Null when the page quotes a per-GPU rate only.

fields.name: usd_per_hour
fields.description: On-demand hourly price in USD. An 8xH100 node is ~$25/hr, so anything above 100 is a total-cost figure, not an hourly rate.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Page the row was read from. Injected by the harness -- extractors must leave this None.
